text:
Priya R.: quick handoff — HelioBank VIP load test + go-live watch tomorrow 2026-03-18 16:00-20:00 UTC. FYI a few risk items below, assigning coverage notes.

Priya R.: TL;DR: expected peak ~1.2k concurrent sessions, bursty RPS (~3k for 30s), using dedicated-gpu-pool-4 with model: rdlw-v2-quant. Contract SLA: p99 latency <= 220ms for inference; legal asked for an ops playbook (linked).

Priya R.: Risks:
- TLS cert on ingress edge expires in 4 days (ticket #INF-3421), patching schedule unclear. If renew fails we need fallback domain route.
- KV cache cold-start on worker pool after scale-up — warm paths ahead of test.
- Autoscale policy: max=20 replicas but current instance size may hit OOM for long sequences; consider temp scale to 30 for the window.
- Canary deploy planned at +30m; if latency regresses >10% rollback to rdlw-v2-quant-rc1.

Lucas M.: ack, I'll take 16:00-00:00 UTC watch. Can someone confirm cert owner? I can reach out to infra-priv if needed. Also please reserve burst capacity quota for dedicated-gpu-pool-4.

Jamie K.: cert owner is infra-ssl (cc @infra-ssl). I pinged them — they said they can rotate but need a maintenance window. I'll open a short hold if rotation collides with test.

Jamie K.: to warm KV cache run this on one worker (10m before start):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s "https://private-serve/kv/warm?prefix=user:" >/dev/null; done
```
Works fine and keeps per-token warm.

Priya R.: putting the short rollback playbook here for oncall:
- If p99 > 240ms for >2 consecutive 5m windows: 1) route traffic to fallback-model (rdlw-v2-quant-rc1) 2) scale pool down to baseline while keeping warmers 3) open incident channel and tag @sre-lead.

Emily S.: note from PM/legal: HelioBank contract has a clause for credits if monthly availability dips below SLA threshold. Let's avoid that. Also please enable extra request tracing for the window — add header X-Helio-Trace to all requests so we can map traces to customer session IDs.

Lucas M.: will add trace header via the routing policy. Also will change Autoscale max to 30 for 16:00-20:00 UTC and then revert. Leaving an infra change ticket: #INF-3458.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy rdlw-v2-quant -> dedicated-gpu-pool-4 at 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z (canary enabled).

Priya R.: handoff notes: I'm online until 16:10 UTC to support deploy and rollback. After that Lucas covers until midnight. Night coverage: need pickup in rotation (who can take 00:00-08:00?). If no one picks up, escalate to oncall-rotation as usual.

Lucas M.: i can stay til 02:00 UTC if needed. If anyone else can do 02:00-08:00 pls shout.

Jamie K.: I'll keep a standby for cert rotation during the window. If rotation can't be completed, we'll add temporary CNAME to helio-fallback.redwood-inference.net and update routing policy.

Emily S.: thanks team. I've uploaded the customer-facing watchdeck + runbook to the HelioBank folder (link). Please add any obs timeline notes there.

Priya R.: final quick ops checklist (copy/paste):
- reserve burst quota (done? @cloud-alloc)
- run KV warm script 10m prior
- enable X-Helio-Trace header
- set autoscale max=30 for window (#INF-3458)
- verify cert rotation or fallback CNAME (#INF-3421)
- monitor p99 and token costs, page if p99>240ms

Lucas M.: got it. I'll post an update 5m before start and another at +45m.

Priya R.: :thumbsup: thanks everyone — feel free to ask quick Qs here.
